title: unboringspec insights v1

Attention.description: How much human judgment an item needs. This drives what the reviewer sees first.
Attention.title: Attention

Citation.description: A pointer to the exact line in the spec documents that supports a claim.

file.description: Document path exactly as shown in the '===== FILE: <path> =====' header.
file.title: File

line.description: 1-based line number as shown in the numbered document.
line.title: Line

Citation.title: Citation

DecisionInsight.description: A meaningful choice the spec makes (architecture, scope, data, UX, trade-off).

choice.description: What was decided, in one sentence.
choice.title: Choice

rationale.description: Why, as stated or implied by the spec.
rationale.title: Rationale

risk.description: What could go wrong with this choice. Empty if nothing notable.
risk.title: Risk

attention.description: 'decide': unresolved, ambiguous or high-risk, needs a human call. 'review': a reasonable person could disagree. 'routine': conventional.

DecisionInsight.title: DecisionInsight

DiagramInsight.description: A Mermaid diagram that helps a reviewer understand the spec without reading all of it.

kind.description: 'system': the map of the parts involved (people, apps, services, data stores, external systems) and how they connect; 'journey': the main user journey; 'sequence': a key interaction between actors and systems; 'flow': another important process; 'state': the lifecycle of a central object.
kind.title: Kind

mermaid.description: Plain Mermaid source starting with its type (flowchart for system, journey and flow; sequenceDiagram; stateDiagram-v2). Names from the spec. No init directives, click handlers, links or HTML. Max 40 lines.
mermaid.title: Mermaid

sources.description: Lines the diagram is based on.
sources.title: Sources

DiagramInsight.title: DiagramInsight

QuestionInsight.description: A gap, contradiction or missing edge case a careful reviewer would raise.

why_it_matters.description: One sentence on the consequence of leaving it open.
why_it_matters.title: Why It Matters

QuestionInsight.title: QuestionInsight

RiskInsight.description: A delivery or product risk, including ones the spec implies but does not name.

impact.description: What happens if the risk materialises.
impact.title: Impact

mitigation.description: A concrete way to reduce it.
mitigation.title: Mitigation

RiskInsight.title: RiskInsight

description: unboringspec insights: what a human reviewer needs from a spec, with every claim cited.

one_liner.description: What is being built and for whom, max 25 words.
one_liner.title: One Liner

bullets.description: Up to 5 things a reviewer must know, max 20 words each.
bullets.title: Bullets

you_must_decide.description: Only items that genuinely need a human call. May be empty.
you_must_decide.title: You Must Decide

diagrams.description: Optional, at most 3, most useful first. The task graph and the data model are drawn from the spec automatically.
diagrams.title: Diagrams
